Supreme Court Oversees Bar Council Policy Decisions

The Supreme Court has ordered oversight of policy decisions made by the Bar Council of India (BCI). The court questioned the five-year tenure of BCI Chairman Mannan Kumar Mishra, with one report indicating his continuation was under scrutiny. The court also instructed the BCI to stay out of disciplinary matters concerning law students.
